Users can search events based on date, location, and category. The system implements JWT-based authentication and role-based access control to ensure secure API access. This project demonstrates the implementation of Django models, serializers, viewsets, routers, API versioning, and REST API testing using Postman.

questions.questionText: Create the Movie Recommendation and Review System is a web-based application built using the Django Framework and Django REST Framework that enables users to explore movie listings, submit reviews, and receive personalized movie recommendations. The system allows administrators to manage movie data through CRUD operations while users can search and filter movies based on genres and ratings. The recommendation feature uses simple machine learning techniques to suggest movies based on user preferences. The application provides REST APIs for accessing movie data and uses JWT authentication for secure user access. This project demonstrates integration of web development, REST API design, and machine learning concepts.
